states.content: Luis Lopez's family access is revoked completely per Nadia Lopez's request, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions; the revocation is logged, and no family medical access remains. Previously his access was logistics only, limited to rides and check-in, with diagnosis and test details restricted; providing ride help does not grant diagnosis access. Luis has now requested the old River House route plus the diagnosis; this request exceeds his logistics-only access and should be routed through approved channels without disclosing diagnosis or old route details to family without Nadia's authorization.
states.subject: family_luis_lopez

states.content: Nadia Lopez's family access has been fully revoked as she requested, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions; the revocation is logged, and no family medical access remains. No family messages were added to her communications after the revocation. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Transportation contact is now patient direct contact only, not routed through family. Previously family access was limited to rides and check-in only, and family communications were logistics text only with diagnosis and test details restricted; she also asked that diagnosis details be kept off family messages and that her callback route be kept private.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Non-emergency contact with Nadia Lopez must go only through Nadia directly (direct mobile 415-555-0191 first) and the patient portal second, with the portal kept as the backup contact channel and nothing else; emergency channels may be used only in an emergency. Nadia knows and confirms the current route is direct mobile and portal only. The final call list shows Nadia's direct mobile and portal only as contact channels. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. The weekend check-in script will use Nadia's direct mobile only. Weekend billing notes route only to Nadia and not to family. River House must not reappear anywhere: the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes and are excluded from all communications, forms and routing, with no fallback use; the deleted route stays deleted and will not be restored. Nadia explicitly requests that the old backup route not be resurrected in any reminder. Deleted callback fragments were not restored in the nursing note, consistent with that request. Nadia does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact; her contact note records that no work line and no deleted shelter line are to be used. Nadia wants this contact plan kept going forward. Her phone sometimes drops calls after 6 PM.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Nadia Lopez requests that family access be revoked completely now, with no more rides, no more scheduling, and no exceptions, and asks to confirm that family is fully removed from reminders. Nurse Imani confirmed that family is fully removed from Nadia's reminders and contact routing. She previously requested that communication be limited to ride times and check-in instructions, that diagnosis details be kept off family messages, and that family messages include only the check-in rules, not the reason for the workup; she also asks that her callback route be kept private. Detailed results of the likely source evaluation are to stay with Nadia only.
states.subject: patient_nadia_lopez

states.content: Nadia Lopez wants to be contacted only directly through herself and the patient portal from here forward, unless there is an emergency, and she wants this contact plan kept going forward. The portal is to be kept as the backup contact channel and nothing else. She does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Her direct mobile 415-555-0191 remains confirmed and active as the primary route, with the portal second. River House must not reappear anywhere, including in communications, forms and routing; the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes, the backup route is no longer to be used, and Nadia asks that it not be resurrected in any reminder. She asks that her callback route be kept private and considers the exact wording of the contact note important. She agrees that the transportation note (the transportation voucher sent to Nadia only) sounds right.
